home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Pick how you want to drive today.
home.body: This is your main screen with bottom navigation.

update.title: Update available
update.body: A newer version of the app is ready. Updating takes a minute and keeps rides coming through properly.
update.bodyRequired: This version is no longer supported. Update the app to carry on driving.

quickRide.onlineBody: Ride requests near you will show up here.
quickRide.offlineBody: Go online to start receiving ride requests.
quickRide.reconnectingBody: Your spot is held for a few minutes. Hang tight.
quickRide.dutyLockedBody: Sharing your location with the rider until this ride is finished.
quickRide.emptyBody: Tap Go online and nearby ride requests will start arriving.
quickRide.waitingBody: You're in the queue. New requests appear the moment a rider books nearby.
quickRide.bidLocked: One bid at a time — withdraw your live bid to bid here.
quickRide.withdrawBody: The rider won't see your offer any more. You can bid again while the ride is open.
quickRide.cannotLower: You've already bid {{amount}}, which is the lowest fare allowed on this ride. A bid can only be lowered, never raised.
quickRide.bidNote: Bids run for 60 seconds. You can lower a bid, but never raise it.
quickRide.bidFailed: Couldn't place your bid. Please try again.
quickRide.onRideToDrop: Trip in progress — head to the drop.
quickRide.blockKycBody: Aadhaar verification is required before you can accept rides.
quickRide.blockVehicleBody: Add the vehicle you'll be driving so we know which rides to send you.
quickRide.blockLocationBody: We need your location to match you with nearby riders. Allow location access and try again.
quickRide.blockConnectionBody: Check your connection and try going online again.
quickRide.blockUnknownBody: Something went wrong. Please try again.

duty.serviceBody: Looking for rides near you. Tap to open.
duty.serviceFailed: Your phone may stop sending you rides once you leave the app. Check the permissions and go online again.

permissions.title: A few things before you go online
permissions.subtitle: Your phone will quietly stop sending you rides without these. It takes about a minute, and you only do it once.
permissions.blockedHint: Location access all the time is needed to go online.

backgroundLocation.title: Location all the time
backgroundLocation.body: Keeps your position moving for the rider once you put the phone away. Sharing stops the moment you go offline.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: How a new ride reaches you when the app isn't open. Turned off, your phone drops these without a sound.

overlay.title: Display over other apps
overlay.body: Shows a new ride as a card on top of whatever you're using, so you don't miss one while you're in Maps.

battery.title: Unrestricted battery
battery.body: Stops your phone closing the app in the background and dropping you out of dispatch without telling you.

busy.quickRideBody: Finish it and new work starts arriving again straight away.
busy.outstationTitle: You already have an outstation trip
busy.outstationBody: One accepted trip at a time. Your standing bids on other trips are unaffected.
busy.imminentTitle: Your trip is about to depart
busy.imminentBody: New work is paused within two hours of an outstation pickup, so you can set off on time.
busy.title: You can't take work right now
busy.body: Something you're already committed to is holding you. Pull down to check again.

outstation.offlineNote: You're offline. Trips below are still yours to bid on — you just won't be alerted when new ones come up.
outstation.bidNote: Outstation bids don't expire. Yours stays with the rider until they choose, you withdraw it, or the trip is taken.
outstation.withdrawBody: The rider won't see your offer any more. You can bid again while the trip is open.

empty.noneBody: Long-distance trips within 20 km will show up here, including ones booked for later this month.
empty.filteredBody: No trips match the departure you picked. Try All to see everything on offer.
empty.busyBody: You'll start seeing outstation trips again once you're free to take one.

outstationRide.title: Your trip
outstationRide.bannerAssigned: This trip is yours. Come back when it's time to set off.
outstationRide.bannerArriving: You're on the way — the rider can see you moving.
outstationRide.bannerInProgress: The rider is on board — they can still see you moving.
outstationRide.departsNote: You can keep taking QuickRides until two hours before this departure. Nothing is shared with the rider until you set off.
outstationRide.navigateDropNote: Google Maps is a separate app — come back here to complete the trip when you arrive. Either way the rider keeps seeing you move.
outstationRide.mapsFailed: Couldn't open Google Maps on this phone.
outstationRide.startBody: This tells the rider you're on the way and starts sharing your location with them. Only do it when you're actually leaving.
outstationRide.startFailed: Couldn't start the trip. Please try again.
outstationRide.otpBody: Ask the rider for their 4-digit code and enter it once they're in the car.
outstationRide.otpFailed: Couldn't confirm the pickup. Please try again.
outstationRide.otpLocked: Too many incorrect attempts. This trip is locked — call the rider, then contact support to sort it out.
outstationRide.otpLockedBody: This trip is locked after too many wrong codes. Call the rider to check the code they were given, and contact support if it still won't start.
outstationRide.startFirst: Set off first, then confirm the pickup.
outstationRide.completeBody: Only do this once the rider has reached the drop-off.
outstationRide.completeFailed: Couldn't complete the trip. Please try again.
outstationRide.trackingFailed: We couldn't share your location. The rider can't see you moving — check your connection and that location is on.

history.title: Your rides
history.subtitle: Everything you've driven, newest first.
history.emptyBody: Once you finish your first ride it'll show up here with what you earned.
history.noMatchBody: Nothing here for the period and statuses you picked. Widen the filter to see more.

filter.title: Filter rides
filter.statusHint: Leave all unpicked to see every status.

history.outstationBody: Long-distance trips you've driven will be listed here with what you earned.

ride.noCoordinates: This ride has no location to navigate to.
ride.otpBody: Ask the rider for their 4-digit code and enter it to start the trip.

ride.otpLocked: Too many incorrect attempts. This ride is locked — call the rider, then contact support to sort it out.

ride.completeBody: Only do this once the rider has reached the drop-off.
ride.completeFailed: Couldn't complete the ride. Please try again.

navigate.arrived: You've arrived. Close the map when you're done with directions.
navigate.noFix: Waiting for a GPS signal. Check that location is on.
navigate.serviceUnreachable: Couldn't reach the navigation service. If you're online, this is a problem on our side, not yours.
navigate.routeUnreachable: Couldn't fetch the route. If you're online, this is a problem on our side, not yours.
navigate.quotaError: In-app navigation is temporarily unavailable. Please tell support.
navigate.badDestination: This destination can't be routed to.
navigate.noPermission: Location access is needed to navigate.
navigate.notAuthorized: In-app navigation isn't enabled for this app yet.
navigate.termsDeclined: Navigation terms declined. Accept them to navigate.

navigate.soundOff: Voice guidance muted — tap to unmute

rideSuccess.title: Ride completed
rideSuccess.body: Nice work. You're back online and new requests are on their way.
rideSuccess.collectBody: Show this to the rider — scanning it pays you {{amount}}.
rideSuccess.noUpi: Add a UPI ID in Profile → Manage payment to show a payment QR here.

reviews.title: My reviews
reviews.emptyBody: Ratings riders leave after a ride will show up here.

subscription.title: My plan
subscription.planTagline: Everything you need to drive, at no cost.
subscription.note: Your free plan is active on your account and there is nothing to pay today. If that ever changes, we'll tell you in the app well before it does.

quickRide.title: Unlimited QuickRide rides
quickRide.body: Take as many live rides as you want — no daily cap, no ride limit.

outstation.title: Unlimited outstation trips
outstation.body: Bid on every long-distance trip that comes up, as often as you like.

alerts.title: Live ride alerts
alerts.body: Nearby ride requests reach you the moment a rider books.

payouts.title: Direct UPI payouts
payouts.body: Riders pay to your UPI id — the fare comes to you, not through us.

support.title: Help when you need it
support.body: Support and the help pages are open to you at any time.

welcome.title: Welcome aboard!
welcome.body: Your free plan is already active on your account — you're ready to start taking rides.

kyc.title: Aadhaar KYC
kyc.statusVerifiedBody: Your Aadhaar has been verified. Nothing more to do here.
kyc.statusPendingBody: Verify your Aadhaar through DigiLocker to start accepting rides.
kyc.confirmingBody: Checking your verification with our servers. This takes a few seconds.
kyc.step1: Tap Verify with Aadhaar to open DigiLocker.
kyc.step2: Give consent, then enter your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your linked mobile.
kyc.step3: Come back to the app — we confirm the result automatically.
kyc.consentNote: You are handed over to DigiLocker, the Government of India service. We never see your Aadhaar number or OTP.
kyc.verifiedNote: Your Aadhaar details are stored securely and are never shown in the app.
kyc.stillProcessing: Verification is still processing. This can take a moment — try again shortly, and contact support if it keeps failing.
kyc.statusFailedBody: We couldn't verify your Aadhaar. You can start the verification again.
kyc.startFailed: Verification is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
kyc.webviewFailed: Couldn't load the verification page. Please try again.
kyc.statusFailed: Couldn't check your verification status. Pull down to refresh.
kyc.videoFailed: Couldn't open the video on this phone.
kyc.processingBody: Hang on while we confirm your Aadhaar verification. This takes a few seconds.
kyc.continueFailed: Couldn't load your verified details. Please try again.
